name: atax
signature: void atax(long m, long n, const double *A, const double *x, double *y, double *tmp)
layout: A is an m x n matrix stored row-major: element (i, j) is A[i*n + j]. x and y have n elements, tmp has m elements. y is output only and its initial contents are undefined. tmp may be used as scratch space. No two arrays overlap. m and n are at least 1.
